name: Essence of Rage
subtitle: just like mom used to make
rules: Choose one of the following as this card's rules text: -- OPTION 1 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character or faction. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character or faction. -- OPTION 2 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 2 strength. -- OPTION 3 -- EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character.
notes: Catalog option 1 omits the 'EFFECT:' label (formatting only).

name: Fervent Beastslayer
subtitle: he loves what he does
rules: [R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 3 life.
flavor: "My lifelong dream? To find a beast that, like, spits out more beasts, which spit out more beasts. Man, I could slay that forever."

name: Frenzied Shriever
subtitle: you should probably just stand back
rules: When this card inflicts battle damage to a character, increase the amount by 2.

name: Gallant Commander
subtitle: let's do this!
rules: CHARGE! -- COST – Pay 2. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Inflict 3 damage to an opponent's faction.
flavor: "You ain't afraid of a little rain, are ya boys?"

name: Gideon, the Ultimate Warrior
subtitle: another white hetero male power fantasy
typeLine: WARLORD CHARACTER – gideon, sword of great justice
rules: UNIQUE GIDEON -- When battle damage is inflicted to this card while it's attacking, reduce the amount to 0. -- When an opponent's faction loses influence, increase the amount by 1.
flavor: Child of the [REDACTED].

name: Godwing Thunderhoof
subtitle: my teeth are swords
rules: UNIQUE GODWING -- When this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict X damage to it, where X is the number of [R] you control.
flavor: My claws are spears. My wings are a HURRICANE!

name: Goutflame Talonclaw
subtitle: D. I. A. G. F. (Die in a Godzilla fire)
rules: UNIQUE GOUTFLAME TALONCLAW -- When this card enters play, you may pick a location, item and/or character. If you do, destroy the picked cards. -- Opponents cannot take control of this card and it cannot be blocked by characters with 1 strength or less. -- If this card would be destroyed or removed from the game, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- FLIP UP – 9 [R][R][R][R][R]
notes: Footer also prints 'Design and likeness by 2013 World Champion Matt "moxless" Kucklinca' (player-designed card credit).

name: Heavy Sword
subtitle: stand still, will ya!
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength. -- [R][R][R][R] – The attached character gains an additional 2 strength. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 4. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.

name: Idol Smasher
subtitle: it's finally over
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick an item. -- When this card enters play, if you picked an item as part of its cost, destroy that item.
flavor: They really ruined it by the end, but it's finally over.

name: Implosive Explosion
subtitle: two great tastes that taste great together
rules: EXTRA COST – Reveal a face-down resource card you control. X is its numeric cost. Destroy it. Pick a character or location. -- Inflict X damage to the character or location. Put this card into play under its owner's control as a face-down resource instead of into their discard pile.

name: Impressive Hero
subtitle: with a really big friend
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick a character. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost, deplete that character.
flavor: "That's what I THOUGHT! You didn't expect to see a sword like THIS, did you!?"

name: Improvised Blowtorch
subtitle: feel the burn
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- Inflict 2 damage to the character. -- FLIP UP – 1 [R]

name: Invade!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- This turn, the character cannot block. -- REUSE – [R][R] -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 4. Discard a card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character cannot block.
flavor:
"In a fury, Adriel and the newly born Barduse descended on the capital for revenge."
— Marduun, A Forgotten History
notes: No subtitle printed under the name.

name: Lordly Stables
subtitle: four things greater than all things are
rules: When an attacking character you control inflicts battle damage to a character, increase the amount by 1.
flavor: Women and Horses and Power and War.

name: Manful Skirmish
subtitle: the way wars were meant to be decided
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick 3 characters. -- Deplete one of the characters. Inflict 1 damage to another one of the characters. The remaining character gains 2 strength this turn. Draw a card.

name: Mass Confusion
subtitle: these ones won't fight back!
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Pick a player. Pick X characters that player controls. -- Inflict Y damage divided however you want to the characters, where Y is the number of characters that player controls minus the number of characters you control.

name: Midget Mine
subtitle: only 50% effective on non-midgets
rules: AMBUSH -- COST – Pick an attacking character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 5 [R]

name: Mighty Ballista
subtitle: ready the MISS-ILE!
rules: This card enters play depleted. -- FIRE! -- COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Deplete this card. Pick a character or location. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character or location. Inflict X damage to this card.

name: Necromantic Healer
subtitle: bringing life to some and less life to others
rules: When battle damage is inflicted to a character in a party with this card, reduce the amount by 1. (This includes this character.)
flavor: It's a win-win situation.
notes: Footer also prints 'original Open R&D concept by kallisti'.

name: Nimble Conscript
subtitle: boot to the head
flavor: "OK, then I'm going to start kicking air like this. And if any part of you should fill that air, it's your own fault."

name: Padamose, Emperor of Marduun
subtitle: likes: swords, great justice, being emperor
rules: UNIQUE PADAMOSE -- All your "sword of great justice" characters gain 1 strength and 1 life. -- All your opponent's "mau" characters and Arcanist characters lose 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: dislikes: wizards, lesser mau, being devoured alive by giant tentacle monsters.
notes: Footer also prints 'original Open R&D concept by w4r10rd'.

name: Perforate
subtitle: sheeesh que-babb
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. Pick a character. -- Inflict X damage to the character.

name: Phalludrix, the Impotenator
subtitle: it's easy to get a rise out of him
rules: UNIQUE PHALLUDRIX -- When an effect controlled by an opponent causes you to discard any number of cards, you may put them back into your hand. -- EQUIP -- COST – Pick a character. If it is an "adriel" card then X is 0, otherwise X is 3. Pay X. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character. -- The attached character gains 2 strength. -- At the start of each opponent's turn, you may restore the attached character.
flavor: If impotentated for more than four hours, seek arcanological attention.
notes: Printed 'an "adriel" card' has quote marks around adriel (catalog lacks them); no gameplay difference.

name: Plunging Shriever
subtitle: if meat's bad for you, then how come it's food?
rules: When this card enters play, you may pick an item. If you do, destroy that item and your faction loses 2 influence. -- FLY AWAY -- COST – Remove an item in an opponent's discard pile from the game. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R][R]

name: Proficient Battler
subtitle: standing out in a crowd
rules: FLIP UP – 2 [R]
flavor: In battle, beauty is the ultimate advantage.

name: Righteous Exemplar
subtitle: better than being wrongeous
rules: [R][R][R][R][R] – This card gains 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: "Die in ignorance. I have no more time for you."

name: Robustical Badass
subtitle: ripped and ready for anything
rules: [R][R][R] – At the start of your turn, you may inflict 1 damage to an opponent's faction.
flavor: Now, if only something would happen...

name: Seraphim Magic
subtitle: go forth and DIE!
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a character. -- This turn, the character gains 3 strength. Draw a card.

name: Spiky Pumpkin
subtitle: first the slaughter. then the pie.
rules: This card enters play with 3 tokens on it. -- At the start of your turn, remove a token from this card. If there are no tokens on it, destroy it. -- At the end of your turn, you may pick a character. If you do, inflict X damage to that character, where X is the number of tokens on this card.

name: Spitting Sarume
subtitle: they didn't see it coming
rules: When this card enters play, inflict 1 damage to all characters an opponent controls. -- FLIP UP – 3 [R]
flavor: And they'll never see again.

name: Storm the Gates
subtitle: this is how the Empire ends
rules: EXTRA COST – Destroy a character you own. Pick a character your opponent owns. -- Inflict 5 damage to the character. If the character was destroyed by that damage, draw a card. -- FLIP UP – 1 [R]
flavor:
"In the end, it came down to Thabbashites versus Adriel and the newly formed Barduse versus Lingamites, Swords and the Seraphim. The winner? Don't be naïve."
— Marduun, A Forgotten History

name: Surplus Soldier
subtitle: i got a ninety-nine problems, but a soldier ain't one
rules: If this card would be destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead.
flavor: Why do they always sell uniforms in packs of ten, but sell soldiers in packs of twelve?

name: The Emperor Barduse
subtitle: Gideon is gone. Only Barduse remains.
rules: UNIQUE EMPEROR BARDUSE -- When this card enters play, you may pick any number of characters. If you do, inflict X damage divided however you want to the characters, where X is twice the number of "dragon" characters you control. -- All your other "dragon" characters gain 1 strength and 1 life.
flavor: Forged in a crucible of desperation and failure.
notes: Footer also prints 'original Open R&D concept by w4r10rd'.

name: The Emperor Born
subtitle: inside every Gideon...
rules: EXTRA COST – Deploy this only not during a battle. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- You may deploy the character. -- REUSE – [R] -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 4. Pick a character in your discard pile. Discard a card. -- EFFECT – You may deploy the character.
flavor: ...there's a demonic dragon-despot waiting to be let out.

name: The Enemy's Head
subtitle: stuffed, pickled, mounted on a pike
rules: When a character an opponent controls is destroyed, you may pay 1. If you do, put a token on this card. -- Characters you control gain 1 strength for each token on this card.
flavor: Made into a goblet, encased in a bowling ball.

name: Tiny Sarume
subtitle: expedient eater of toes
rules: FLIP UP – 0 [R]

name: Trebuchet Officer
subtitle: he's grrrrrreat
rules: FIRE! -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the location.

name: Unflinching Bowman
subtitle: there is nothing around you
rules: SHOOT -- COST – Pay 1. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 1 damage to the character. Inflict 1 damage to this card.
flavor: There is only you and your target.

name: Vigilant Raider
subtitle: oh, that's a nicol rorix killmouth kite of hell
rules: ASSAIL -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 1 strength.
flavor: Imagine that. Dragons. Much wow.

name: Violence
rules: This card provides – [R][R] -- When this card enters play, your faction loses 1 influence.
notes: Landscape (rotated) resource card, no subtitle. Same two sentences as the catalog but in the opposite order (card prints 'This card provides [R][R]' first, then the enters-play influence loss).

name: Virtuous Razer
subtitle: hammer time!
rules: When this card inflicts battle damage, you may pick a location. If you do, inflict the same amount of damage to that location.

name: Vorpal Sword
subtitle: surprisingly effective versuses Jabberwocks
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength and 1 life. -- If this card would be destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- SNICKER SNACK -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 3. Discard a card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. Inflict 1 damage to your faction.
notes: Item badges +2 STR / +0 SPD / +1 LIFE. Footer also prints 'original Open R&D card name by' (credit name cut off). Subtitle prints 'versuses' as shown.

name: Watchtower
subtitle: there must be some kind of way out of here
rules: UNIQUE WATCHTOWER -- When a character enters play under an opponent's control, inflict 1 damage to it.
flavor: Said the joker to the thief.
